messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident opened — ingress/ALB 5xx spike detected in euc2b (thread 2532109876)
oncall-alex: I'm on it, paging SRE primary now. seeing alerts from edges-5xx-rate > 300rps
sre-tariq: grabbing dashboards — 5xx and connreset counters jumped at ~10:03 UTC for tg-ingress-euc2b
eng-runtime-leah: fyi we rolled envoy-edge v2 as a small canary at 09:58 in euc2, could be related but need data
netops-jamie: running quick network checks — traceroute to loadbalancer in euc2b shows intermittent packet loss to AZ B TOR switch
support-maria: we have a handful of incoming high-priority tickets from EU customers, errors are 502/504, surface-level impact ~10% of EU traffic so far
product-ella: any AoE? Regional or global?
oncall-alex: looks AZ-scoped from metrics; setting Sev2 until we have containment
sre-tariq: following runbook step 1: describe target health
sre-tariq: ```aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:eu:123456:targetgroup/tg-ingress-euc2b/abcdef```
eng-runtime-leah: envoy logs from euc2b show repeated: "upstream reset: connection reset by peer" for several backends
netops-jamie: opening cloud provider console — noticing elevated link errors for euc2b fabric port, ping jitter high
sre-tariq: target health status: many targets Unhealthy (ConnectionError) and draining from AZ B only
incident-bot: Note: when AZ-only LB failures seen, recommended mitigation: remove AZ from ALB rotation and/or shift traffic via weighted DNS
netops-jamie: applying AZ removal for ALB to avoid euc2b, will flip weights after confirmation
support-maria: preparing statuspage draft: "We are investigating increased errors for EU traffic, partial region impact."
eng-runtime-leah: will also kick a rollback of envoy-edge canary if traffic doesn't stabilize. preparing rollback command
deploy-bot: Canary rollback job queued for envoy-edge-v2 in euc2
netops-jamie: ```aws elbv2 set-subnets --load-balancer-arn arn:aws:... --subnets subnet-a,subnet-c``` (removing AZ B equivalent) — mock command
sre-tariq: ALB AZ removal applied, watching healthchecks and request rates
eng-runtime-leah: starting rollback now — decreasing new envoy connections in euc2b
sre-tariq: post-AZ removal: 5xx rate dropped ~70% in region, healthy counts for remaining AZs stable
support-maria: update: affected customers ~15, backlog of failed requests estimated 180k, ETA for full mitigation TBD
netops-jamie: starting weighted DNS shift to route a portion of residual traffic to euc1 as extra safety (low-latency customers kept local via NLB fallback)
oncall-alex: handing primary to @sre-tariq for next 30m, I'll remain reachable for customer escalations
sre-tariq: ack — primary. monitoring dashboards and will escalate if regression
eng-runtime-leah: monitoring logs — connection resets decreasing, roll-back looks effective
deploy-bot: Canary rollback completed in euc2, rollout status: reverted -> stable
sre-tariq: 5xx now almost back to baseline, connreset spikes near zero, marking incident mitigated for external traffic
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation applied and traffic stabilized. Please capture initial RCA notes in the thread and assign postmortem owners
product-ella: recommend postmortem — double-check rollout gating and per-AZ health thresholds. Assigning eng-runtime-leah + netops-jamie to lead
support-maria: customer impact summary draft: start 10:03 UTC, mitigation 10:42 UTC, affected EU customers (~12-18%), ~200k failed reqs, no data loss reported
oncall-alex: follow-ups: open cloud provider ticket referencing possible fabric/transit issue in euc2b, enable packet capture for deeper analysis, add an alert for per-AZ connreset rate
netops-jamie: cloud provider case opened: CLOUD-9876, they reported transient switch flap in euc2b around same window, will provide logs
eng-runtime-leah: action items: add increased healthcheck backoff for ALB, tighten canary traffic gating, add runbook step for immediate AZ isolation
sre-tariq: assigning final postmortem to eng-runtime-leah and netops-jamie, timeline + remediation plan due by EOD, I'll own follow-up verification tomorrow
product-ella: communications: support to send customer notice + high-touch outreach list prepared by @support-maria
oncall-alex: nice quick response everyone — good coordination. closing incident channel once postmortem assigned :clap:
